bugs.rationale: RUSTSEC-2020-0142 / CVE-2020-36462: Bucket2<T> exposes `unsafe impl<T> Send for Bucket2<T>` with no `T: Send` bound. Pushing a non-Send T (e.g. Rc) into the pool and pulling it on a different thread crosses the thread boundary on a !Send value -- send-bound violation that can lead to data races on T's interior state. Fixed in 0.1.6.
